diffs.evidence: NXP PCF8591 datasheet (A/D conversion, Fig. 'A/D conversion characteristics of single-ended inputs'): 'Vlsb = (VREF - VAGND) / 256'. The scale is ratiometric to VREF, not fixed. On the YL-40 module VREF is tied to VCC and AGND to GND, so 1 LSB = VCC/256. The second reading's 0.01953125 = 5.0/256 assumes a 5 V supply; the model's 0.012890625 = 3.3/256 assumes the 3.3 V supply it documents (description: 'the simulator assumes a 3.3 V supply'; driver default vref=3.3), which is the correct and safe choice for ESP32/Pico boards whose GPIO are not 5 V tolerant. Both apply the same datasheet formula with different reference voltages.
